packs.description: Packs to include in addition to auto-detected ones (e.g. "motion" for CSS-only animation work, "design-research").

excludePacks.description: Auto-detected packs to skip. `core` cannot be excluded.

detect.description: Set false to use only `core` plus the packs listed explicitly.

skills.description: Individual catalog skills to add without taking their whole pack.

disabledSharedSkills.description: Rare opt-out for a shared skill that is misleading in this repository. Applied last.

overrides.description: Explicit names of repo-owned components allowed to replace shared components.
